articles.path: Web安全/开发框架/Lean/Lean超大字符串切片的语义错配与引用计数缺陷.md

evidence.finding: The issue author’s observed Lean 4.32.2 / 4.33.0-rc2 versions and Trail of Bits’ claim through 4.33.1 are attributed to their respective sources rather than presented as independently tested across every release. The issue documents the raw extract semantic mismatch and native_decide proof boundary; Trail of Bits explicitly notes the additional native_decide axiom. Fixed commits establish separate fixes: first commit adds lean_inc and says semantic divergence remains; second commit fixes mismatch and fast path. The 4.34.0-rc1 release contains the second fix. No unsupported CVE is invented.

Borrowed versus owned return handling, UAF/data aliasing, the changed regression output and distinction between memory-safety and semantic fixes match the pinned maintainer diffs. The article limits the claim to programs using huge raw positions and distinguishes native evaluation from ordinary kernel checking. Static test review is described without claiming local reproduction.
